about_the_game:
In 1970, Soviet scientists began drilling deep into the Earth. By 1983, they had reached 12,000 meters—but at 14,000 meters, they found something terrifying.

A strange portal lay buried beneath the surface. When a probe was sent in, hell itself was unleashed. Monstrous creatures poured out, attacking the facility and quickly spreading beyond Soviet borders.

At first, the USSR tried to cover it up. But as chaos engulfed the world, they had no choice but to call for a global response. Enter MAMA, an elite unit of highly trained female operatives, tasked with hunting these creatures and uncovering the portal’s true origin.

The world is on the brink. The hunt begins.

Dynamic RPG Battle: 

Engage in strategic RPG-style combat against formidable enemies. Each agent has unique abilities that you can utilize in battle. You can also team up with other agents on specific missions—because no one should have to go it alone.

Sexy married women character to choose from:

Featuring the best women each nation has to offer: Strong, beautiful, and most importantly, deadly. Play as them on specific missions and unlock exclusive naughty scenes along the way.

High quality Sexual CG Scene:

Win or lose? It doesn’t matter! No matter the outcome, you’ll unlock naughty scenes based on the mission results.

Explore Locations and Lore:

More than just a sexual game. MAMA delivers a deep narrative filled with conspiracy theories and alternative events inspired by real-life history, all set during the Cold War era.
